test_title: PYST 8: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The list price of an article is ₹15,000. A trader wants to buy it. he has to choose one out of two discount series - one is 45%, 3%, and 2% and the other is 25%, 12% and 13% - on the list price. How many rupees can he save by choosing right series?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

First Successive discount = 45%, 3%, 2%

Price after discount = 15000 x 0.55 x 0.97 x 0.98 = 7842.45

Discount = 15000 - 7842.45 = 7157.55

Second Successive discount = 25%, 12%, 13%

Price after discount = 15000 x 0.75 x 0.88 x 0.87 = 8613

Discount = 15000 - 8613 = 6387

If choose first successive discount then money-saving = 7157.55 - 6387 = Rs. 770.55 

**∴ Required saving money is Rs. 770.55 **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

First Successive discount = 45%, 3%, 2%

Second Successive discount = 25%, 12%, 13%

Price of article = Rs. 15000

**Formula used:**

Selling price at discount = Marked Price x (100 - discount%)/100

**Calculation:**

Price after first Successive discount discount = (15000 x 55 x 97 x 98)/ 100 x 100 x 100

⇒ 15000 x 0.55 x 0.97 x 0.98 = 7842.45

Discount = 15000 - 7842.45 = 7157.55

Now,

Price after second Successive discount discount = (15000 x 75 x 88 x 87)/ 100 x 100 x 100

⇒ 15000 x 0.75 x 0.88 x 0.87 = 8613

⇒ Discount = 15000 - 8613 = 6387

If choose first successive discount then money-saving = 7157.55 - 6387 = Rs. 770.55 

∴ Required saving money is Rs. 770.55 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Profit = Selling price - Cost price

Profit% = [(Selling price - Cost price) × 100] ÷ Cost price

Selling price at profit = Cost price x (100 + profit%)/100

Loss = Cost price - Selling price

Loss% = [(Cost price - Selling price) × 100] ÷ Cost price

Selling price at loss = Cost price x (100 - loss%)/100
